scientific_question: For every frozen root-free snapshot, does the full covariance ellipsoid remain denominator-root-free throughout the entire held-out closed x interval, including between observations?

certificate_rule.snapshot: Require sign-consistent nonzero snapshot denominator on the closed interval using exact Sturm root isolation
certificate_rule.squared_support: Construct exact polynomial D(x)^2-rho^2*z(x)^T*Sigma*z(x), where z=(x,x^2,...), and require it to be strictly positive throughout the same closed interval
certificate_rule.interpretation: With sign-consistent D, positivity of the squared support polynomial certifies every denominator in the ellipsoid is root-free over the continuous interval
certificate_rule.non_certification: A root in the squared support polynomial means this certificate is not established; do not call the ellipsoid necessarily unsafe
certificate_rule.arithmetic: Exact rational coefficients and Sturm root isolation; no floating-point grid or sampled perturbation points
certificate_rule.radius: Use the existing certified lower radius from the independent parameter-box analysis without retuning

prohibitions: No covariance refitting, radius retuning or interval selection
No replacement of continuous certification by observed-point checks
No claim that non-certification proves unsafety
No confidence, probability, numerator-perturbation or physical-measurement claim
